issues_detected.description: Only ten of fourteen specified root fields are populated. In particular, root variable metadata and confidentiality classification are absent; component DOIs do not fill the root doi field.
issues_detected.recommendation: Document root-level variables and confidentiality, add a series identifier if available, and describe parent relationships when they exist without substituting component identifiers.

issues_detected.description: Ethics entries identify contacts but do not document review determinations. The deidentified-cell-line rationale is not accompanied by comprehensive applicable consent, privacy-risk or data-protection documentation.
issues_detected.recommendation: Record the basis and responsible authority for the ethics determination, applicable source-consent or access provenance, and a privacy-risk assessment appropriate to these cell-line data.

issues_detected.description: The license, IP conditions and governance contacts are useful, but an explicit confidentiality classification and complete applicable compliance determinations are missing.
issues_detected.recommendation: State confidentiality and applicable compliance determinations, including justified inapplicability where appropriate, alongside the existing governance contact.

issues_detected.description: Standard RO-Crate packaging and resource pointers are documented, but common data identifiers, harmonization rules and procedures for integrating the modalities are not.
issues_detected.recommendation: Document the identifiers and mappings used across assays, typed relationships between resources, and integration procedures that account for incomplete protein-set overlap.

issues_detected.description: FAIRSCAPE packaging is described, but software versions and the analytical transformations producing the released measurements are not sufficiently documented.
issues_detected.recommendation: Provide modality-specific processing inputs, outputs, tools, versions and parameters, plus applicable quality-control, annotation and missing-data handling methods.

issues_detected.description: Collection mechanisms, some collectors and cell sources are described, but acquisition timeframes and complete modality-specific protocols are missing.
issues_detected.recommendation: Add acquisition periods, responsible collectors for each modality and references or details sufficient to identify the collection protocols used for each release.

issues_detected.description: Related publications and component-release citations are present, but the evaluated root CM4AI series has no formal citation.
issues_detected.recommendation: Provide a formal citation identifying the complete series by title and authors or publishing organization, while retaining separate release citations.

issues_detected.description: Limited donor demographics and cell populations are documented, but cell-line selection, inclusion/exclusion and representativeness criteria are not.
issues_detected.recommendation: Explain selection of the cell lines and conditions, applicable inclusion/exclusion criteria, and the populations their measurements can reasonably represent.

issues_detected.description: The download platform and file-selection route are identified, but access tiers and authorization requirements are not explicit. Some underlying datasets are embargoed, and external-data URLs are missing.
issues_detected.recommendation: State whether each access route requires authentication, an agreement or approval, provide external repository URLs, and describe embargo access or release conditions.

issues_detected.description: License and intended/prohibited-use guidance are documented without a comprehensive social-impact analysis and mitigation strategies.
issues_detected.recommendation: Document foreseeable beneficial and harmful uses, discouraged applications, affected groups and concrete mitigations appropriate to functional-genomics and AI-training use.

issues_detected.description: Version history, source descriptions and provenance-graph filenames are available, but the submitted record does not represent complete processing lineage and derivation paths.
issues_detected.recommendation: Supply a textual lineage or graph representation connecting identifiable inputs, processing activities, responsible agents and outputs for the released data.

issues_detected.description: Cell-line and population-coverage limitations are identified without standardized bias categories or analysis of fairness and downstream model effects.
issues_detected.recommendation: Categorize documented biases using an appropriate standard taxonomy and analyze their likely effects on intended uses, with evaluations or mitigations where feasible.

issues_detected.description: The record explicitly reports disagreement between website and Dataverse release dates, differing grant-end and maintenance-plan dates, and undated website metrics that cannot be assigned to a particular release.
issues_detected.recommendation: Retain these qualifications and reconcile the source statements when authoritative clarification becomes available; do not merge their dates or quantities across scopes.

issues_detected.description: The documented RRIDs use the cell-line CVCL namespace. They do not match the instrument's specified SCR_/AB_ patterns, so that restricted pattern check cannot establish their validity; this alone does not demonstrate an incorrect cell-line identifier.
issues_detected.recommendation: Retain the documented identifiers and verify them against the appropriate cell-line registry when identifier verification is authorized.

semantic_insights: The record consistently defines the root as the CM4AI release series and distinguishes current-release statements from older release, preprint and website evidence.
Bridge2AI context is explicitly supported by keywords and funders, and the functional-genomics objectives align with that documented funding context.
The license and commercial-license negotiation requirement are mutually consistent; public access is not treated as unrestricted reuse.
Numeric file sizes and detailed inventories support data discovery without pretending that rounded sizes are exact byte counts.
Release access, quarterly updates and preservation supported by committed institutional funds provide strong maintenance and sustainability documentation.
The absence of predicted cell maps, temporary embargoes and incomplete protein-set overlap are stated directly rather than hidden behind the AI-ready description.
False human-subject and identifiable-element values are populated evidence. They inform semantic interpretation but do not override unknown caller applicability.
